column2: [intro]
The pots and pans come to life
I am the chef, no one can resist me
I cut, I slice, I master
In my kitchen, imagination comes alive
In my kitchen, everything smiles at me
Cooking is good for the mind
With a pinch of love and desire
I mix, I create, that's the recipe
I juggle with spices and flavors
I make the vegetables dance in celebration
With my utensils, I am a star
The kitchen is my conquest ground
In my kitchen, everything smiles at me
Cooking is good for the mind
With a pinch of love and desire
I mix, I create, that's the recipe
[ solo ]
So join me in my enchanted kitchen
Where the dishes simmer with mischief
You'll find culinary poems to taste
Because cooking is my delicious accomplice!
[outro]
